name: Fiducial coverage
description: Advisory: automated pick-and-place needs global fiducials (>= 3, non-collinear) to align the board. Flags boards that carry SMD assembly but too few fiducial-like features. Heuristic (fiducials inferred from geometry, not a fab hard rule).
what_it_measures: Count of global fiducial-like features detected (isolated round copper dots with an oversized mask opening).
